title: Developmental Structure Formation in Organica 1
description: A preregistered empirical account of whether developmental structure emerges in Organica 1, a minimal engine that grows a graph of typed structural candidates across sleep cycles. The paper reports the displacement and preservation indices over a preregistered support-ratio sweep, the failed criteria and the adjacent-difference diagnostic behind them, and an acquisition benchmark that was rebuilt after an endpoint audit and then stopped at its own gate. It also reports the one preregistered test that could still be run at capacity 1,000: held-out next-event prediction against a tuned bigram over 15 confirmatory seeds, where no improvement was detected (pooled margin -0.003818 nats, 98.33% interval [-0.010802, 0.002863] crossing zero, with per-seed margins of both signs), and a withheld-relation margin that improved while the preregistered provenance measure reported it not attributable, so no transfer claim is made in either direction. Negative results are reported as results: the belief-revision comparison against simple baselines came out reversed on all three task families, and the one measured cross-domain transfer result was negative. Every quantitative claim is checked mechanically against the committed artifact it was taken from.
notes: Files: the manuscript as PDF, the manuscript source (Markdown), and the five figures as PDF. The supporting evidence artifacts are in the software record for v0.9.0 and in the repository. Unfunded; no competing interests; ethics not applicable; AI-tool use disclosed in the manuscript's Declarations block.
